scope: Read-only publication preflight plus one root-authorized public-repository guard in source workflow template. No package build, deployment, shared build, branch/index mutation or paid service provisioning.

checks.name: clean-development-packaging
checks.detail: Packager rejects dirty/non-dev source and source changes during export; separate source-specific site/backend/Pages output directories; generated Git bundle records exact source.

checks.name: licensed-font-transport
checks.detail: Pinned759720-byte DejaVuSans.ttf SHA25657f73e11f51999432bf7ab22ce55b6f945d5eca1bf824404cfa9ec2e3718c84e; build copies font+licence; payload carries base64; cloud decodes and verifies pin before API/worker startup.

checks.name: encrypted-export-worker-configuration
checks.detail: API/worker inherit same mode0600 fresh session key,3600000ms explicit TTL and same private SQLite path; parser validates absolute non-symlink private key file and bounds; worker cycles every5seconds.

checks.name: download-cors
checks.detail: Exact Pages origin is allowed; explicit auth/role/contract/If-Match headers allowed; Content-Disposition/Length/Type/Cache-Control exposed; private download uses no-store and authenticated route.

checks.name: safe-two-phase-transport
checks.detail: Runtime excludes Pages files/workflow; Pages-only change does not match cloud/native restart paths; pages writer requires matching existing runtime development source; guarded helper refuses dirty target, malformed paths, duplicates, unexpected workflows, symlink paths and wrong local bundle digest; deletes only stale tracked generated files.

checks.name: no-force-source-publication
checks.detail: Publisher verifies bundle/head and preserves newer or diverged development history; only normal fast-forward push is used.

checks.name: bounded-free-standard-runners
checks.detail: Native template uses public exact-repository/ref guard, standard Ubuntu and Intel macOS, both platforms on push, unsigned iOS Simulator, default upload_artifacts=false. Cloud template now also guards exact public repository; it remains standard Ubuntu and bounded five hours.

authorizedSourceChange.detail: Added exact public-repository job guard only. Lightweight PyYAML parse, exact guard/standard-runner assertions and scoped git diff --check passed. No generated target workflow changed.

publicationOrder: Commit/freeze final development source, finish required checks and package --with-pages once from clean dev branch.

Confirm preview target clean and normally update detached checkout to current remote preview branch. Apply runtime payload; inspect diff and exact source/font/JS/API manifests; commit and normal fast-forward push.
Wait for runtime workflow actual ready status and verify live health, source build-info, CORS, original seeded-media processing and actual report worker download.
Fetch latest preview bot ready commit and update clean target checkout. Require preview/source-head.txt equals packaged development source; apply Pages part only and normal fast-forward push.

Wait for Pages environment deployment and externally verify new /LongBall/ entry, all four roles, exact served artifact/source and export behavior. Record source/run/expiry and native build outcomes without hardware claims.
requiredExternalChecks: preview-status.json state ready, sourceRevision equals runtime transport trigger SHA, future expiresAt and expected run URL. sourceRevision is not the development source SHA.
API /health verifies status/service/contract/syntheticOnly/demoScenario; health does not expose source SHA. Verify development source with API /build-info.json and preview/source-head.txt.
Pages /LongBall/build-info.json and real served JS must match the new Pages package. Combined and Pages JS are separately generated and need separate digests.
Observe real worker CSV/PDF attachment with permitted role and correct CORS/download headers; no capability in URL or public object store.
Confirm both actual native compile jobs and preserve unsigned Simulator/device-testing limitation.
operationalCaveats: Five-hour service is temporary; lasting Pages static entry is separate. No permanent hosting, real account/service or paid provisioning is established.

Pages-only commit advances preview branch after running cloud checkout; later normal cleanup status push may be rejected as non-fast-forward. Current discovery rejects expired expiresAt even if old state remains ready. Do not force-push stale status.
Existing payload/source is historical and must not be published as the new candidate. The report validates preparation/source templates, not a future generated payload or live deployment.
Unresolved privacy/support/device/performance/dependency release gates remain owned by root evidence; this preflight does not approve them.

concurrentOtherOwnerObservation.detail: Global diff check saw trailing whitespace while docs owner was actively editing; notified owner, no out-of-scope edit.
